hero.lead_before: For 15 years we have been transforming southern Guinea-Bissau with education, housing, clean water and technology — so that the
hero.lead_after: and neighboring communities can build their own future.

projects_section.p: Escola Betel is the heart of the mission, but the impact grows when each project removes a concrete barrier to studying, living healthily and dreaming of the future.

school.title: Escola Betel
school.text: Christian basic education and comprehensive formation for children and adolescents.

housing.title: Student House
housing.text: Safe housing for students who live far away and want to keep studying.

radio.title: Voice of Peace Radio
radio.text: Community communication with information, guidance and hope.

water.title: Clean Water
water.text: Access to clean water to protect the health, time and dignity of families.

digital.title: Digital Inclusion
digital.text: Technology as a bridge to learning, work and new opportunities.

sports.title: Sports Gymnasium
sports.text: Sport, community and healthy development for the whole community.

map.p: Partners fund actions with local grounding: a mission embedded in Guinea-Bissau, connected to the Tombali Region and committed to the Cacine Sector.

story.blockquote: "I walked three hours to study. Today I live in the Student House and dream of becoming a teacher."
story.p: Each partnership shortens distances, protects dreams and multiplies leaders who remain serving their own communities.

transparency.h2: Trust for partners, companies, churches and foundations.
transparency.p: Accountability must be simple to understand and easy to follow, with reports, field photos, indicators and evidence of responsible use of resources.

campaign.p: A space for sport, community and comprehensive formation, expanding the school's reach to young people, families and neighboring communities.
